I —

Reality is multidimensional

Current science has demonstrated that we live in a virtual reality. We exist within an energetic system composed of atoms and frequencies, where the reality we perceive as material is, in fact, a projection created by a technology we carry within us.

Through our eyes and senses, we perceive the frequencies of the universe or the quantum field, and through our brain, we interpret them and then project them as material reality. The idea that we inhabit a virtual reality is no longer simply a theory, but a concrete reality.

This does not mean that the material reality we inhabit does not exist or does not have a reality of its own. Quite the opposite: we exist within a concrete material space where we can perceive trees, people, mountains, oceans, and countless physical experiences.

The point is that this is not the only reality.

When human beings speak about “reality,” we are usually referring to this material reality and, more specifically, to our social reality: planet Earth, political and economic systems, countries, borders, religions, work, marriage, children, our relationships, and our social lives. We think of reality as a concrete space that has already been defined and limited according to our collective agreements about what reality is. Very rarely are we simultaneously considering our mental, energetic, conscious, soul, or cosmic reality.

And this is where the problem begins, because the belief that this is the only possible reality limits our potential, our evolutionary capacity, and our capacity for expansion.

To understand The Game, then, we first need to expand our definition of reality.

The Five Dimensions of Reality

We can observe our existence through five different dimensions that coexist and interact continuously. The first is the material dimension: the body, objects, nature, people, and everything we physically perceive. The second is the mental dimension: the space of thoughts, ideas, words, imagination, dreams, our subconscious, our projects, and our creations. The third is the energetic dimension: we are beings composed of atoms and energy, continuously interacting with an energetic field that exists both within and around us.

The fourth is the dimension of consciousness. Consciousness is what allows us to observe, perceive, understand, and expand. It is that inner self capable of observing even our own thoughts, personality, and history; that which learns, evolves, and develops new perspectives through which to understand reality. And finally, there is a fifth dimension: the soul and cosmic dimension. Within it, we can distinguish two deeply interconnected aspects.

The soul dimension corresponds to the deeper identity of the being: the soul that exists before, during, and after a particular human experience. The cosmic dimension expands that perspective even further: it is the greater reality in which that soul also has an origin, a history, relationships, lineages, and connections with other beings and universes.

Philosophical and spiritual traditions throughout history have spoken about this broader reality: spirits, souls, gods, angels, beings of light, enlightened masters, extraterrestrial beings, and countless intelligences interacting with our energetic and human dimensions.

We can look at ancient paintings, Egyptian temples, the pyramids, and all the information they contain about higher beings and the relationship between the human and cosmic dimensions. How are all these realities connected, and what is Reality, with a capital R? If reality is multidimensional, what are we within it?

II —

We are also multidimensional

If we exist simultaneously across different dimensions, then knowing ourselves necessarily means knowing ourselves within all of them. What we are as human beings is much more than what we do or the lives we have. We have a body, a mind, energy, consciousness, and a soul.

Within our bodies, we carry genetics containing the memory of multiple generations. Who we are today does not belong only to us; we are also the result of many generations that existed before us.

Within our minds, we carry a program installed through the energetic frequencies of our father, our mother, our siblings, our grandparents, the schools we attended, the religion we were taught, the culture of the country where we were born, the part of the world in which we live—East or West—and even the reality of planet Earth itself. This conditioning gradually builds a personality based primarily on external structures that we later identify as “who I am.” If we identify only with our thoughts, we leave out our essential being—the one who existed before the programming.

If we do not know our soul, we leave out our deepest identity. And that soul is connected to a cosmic dimension, to a broader knowledge, to beings and universes. That entire network of connections is part of us. As long as we do not know these dimensions, we cannot say that we know ourselves completely.

This is why we speak about healing, liberation, and transformation. About freeing ourselves from inherited patterns, structures, and conditioning, because as we release them, we can begin to truly discover who we came here to be. And the very possibility of changing the way we are and exist shows us that we are more than what we were taught to be.

If I am more than what I was taught to be, who was I before all that conditioning?

The consciousness that incarnates on this planet already arrives with information. The child who begins to grow already carries genetics, a code, information, and potential. That potential is not something separate from us. It is an expanded dimension of what we are, beyond the limited perspective of our human personality. We call that potential the Soul, or the Higher Self, and we can better understand our relationship with that being through The Game.

III —

The Game: The avatar and the player

The concept of the game has appeared throughout many cultures and spiritual philosophies: the game of life, the game of reality. The human experience was designed as a virtual game, a mathematical program in which a virtual space is created where souls can incarnate and live a human experience. This is what cosmic beings call The Game. When we speak about a game, we are not saying that life is unimportant or that it is a joke. Quite the opposite.

The Game is a space for exploration, creativity, curiosity, learning, and experimentation—a space where souls can develop in multiple ways and experience different ways of existing, being, and doing. We can understand this by observing a child.

A child enters a game and takes on a role: they can be the doctor, the police officer, the outlaw, or the artist. They enter the game, fully become that character, and play. Then they move on to another game and take on another role.

As we grow, we continue doing the same thing: we play at being students, at learning, at becoming social beings, going to university, becoming professionals, creating projects, or becoming parents. We can play at being nomads, artists, teachers, entrepreneurs, healers, or travelers. Throughout our lives, we continue moving in and out of different roles. This is why it is called The Game: because it is a continuous space of learning, creation, experimentation, and enjoyment.

The Creators of the Game

Now let us look at this from the perspective of these cosmic beings, also called gods or creators: beings belonging to multiple galaxies and civilizations—Pleiadians, Lemurians, Arcturians, Sirians, Andromedans, and many others.

According to this story and what these beings communicate, this material reality was originally created as an experiment to explore how far work with energy, geometry, alchemy, and science could go. Creating a universe like this was not the work of a single being, but of a collective of beings who decided to create this project: material reality. A reality that appears solid and material, while its essence is energetic. But creating the universe was only one part of the experiment. The next question was how to enter what had been created.

The Avatar

Through this process, different ways of entering this reality were developed. There are accounts of genetic experimentation, the creation of avatars, and the combination of different genetics. Ancient narratives, including Sumerian accounts, speak of geneticist beings and combinations between the genetics of gods, humans, and animals. And through this process, the being we call the human being was gradually created: an avatar. When I speak of an avatar, I am not referring only to the physical body.

The avatar is our incarnated human identity: our body, our human mind, our personality, our history, our conditioning, and our social identity. It is the complete character through which we live this experience. If we understand reality as a game, each human being is the avatar through which a soul enters this reality and lives a human experience. This is why spiritual philosophies have always spoken about incarnation. A soul enters this plane, incarnates through a human seed, becomes a human being, and lives a human life. When that human being dies, the soul and consciousness return to their origin.

And that origin is not only an abstract energetic space. It is also a cosmic origin, a place where cosmic civilizations, cultures, and lineages exist.

The Player

If the human being is the avatar, the soul is the player.

When I use the word player, I am not talking about a third entity separate from the soul or the Higher Self. I am talking about the function that this expanded consciousness performs within the metaphor of The Game. Imagine a role-playing game: there may be fifty players in different parts of the world playing simultaneously.

Each person has their own character inside the game, with a name, a role, certain abilities, and certain tools. But behind each character, there is someone holding the controller. Without that player, the avatar would not exist. In the same way, we can be deeply involved in our human experience without that meaning that our existence ends here. The soul incarnates, but it does not therefore cease to be a higher consciousness or lose its connection with its soul or cosmic dimension.

When we open ourselves to the possibility that there is a Higher Self involved in our lives, with whom we can collaborate and whom we can access, there is also a sense of relief: We are not alone. We can communicate with a higher intelligence and exist within several dimensions simultaneously. That is our multidimensional capacity. When scriptures and spiritual philosophies speak about the God within, they are speaking precisely about this connection. But there is something important here:

The goal is not for the player to replace the avatar. The goal is for them to learn to work together.

The soul needs the human experience in order to enter this reality, feel it, explore it, and transform through it.

The human being is not an obstacle to evolution. It is the vehicle through which evolution becomes experience.

From this perspective, our own body also takes on a different meaning. We are an extraordinarily sophisticated technology. If we observe everything happening inside our bodies—molecular, cellular, energetic, mental, and physiological processes—we can see the extraordinary intelligence that exists within us. The human body is a living technology operating through software and following a systemic logic. It is the vehicle that allows the player to enter material reality. If we are avatars inside a game, do we really know the rules of the game?

IV —

Forgetting: When the avatar loses its connection with the player

We have been taught the human rules. We have been taught that there is an educational process, a history, certain social rules, political structures, emotions, and collective agreements.

But we have not necessarily been taught the rules behind those rules: how energy works, how reality is created, how we can manage our own energy, work with the mind, connect with the wisdom of the body and soul, or consciously use all the dimensions we inhabit. One of the great challenges humanity faces today is that we forgot we were playing a game, and we forgot that the game had more levels. The avatar lost its conscious connection with the player. When an avatar loses that connection, it naturally begins to assume that the level it currently inhabits is the whole of reality.

It begins to build within that level as though it were the only universe available. It loses its sense of belonging, its guidance, and its compass, and completely identifies with its character: its name, its history, its work, its personality, its problems, its beliefs, and everything it was taught it was supposed to be. We were led to believe that this is the only reality that exists and that in order to access other dimensions, we have to die.

But we do not need to die to access the God within. We can bring heaven to Earth and recover that connection while we are alive.

This is why spiritual philosophies have spoken for thousands of years about enlightenment, the search for the Higher Self, the encounter with the God within, and cosmic connection. This was also the knowledge transmitted through the mystery schools: universal laws, the laws of energy, alchemy, and cosmic knowledge. We can ask why we lost this knowledge, who restricted it, why it was declared dangerous, or why it became reserved for only a few. We can speak about power and control and try to reconstruct that history. But for me, that is no longer the most important question.

Who, why, and when no longer matter. That has already happened. The important question now is:

How do we recover the connection?

V —

Evolution: Remembering the rules and moving to the next level

How do we recover the channel, the memory, and the knowledge? How do we free ourselves from limiting beliefs and access our potential? How do we connect with our Higher Self, our cosmic memory, and our energy?

From this perspective, evolution does not mean becoming something else. It means expanding our consciousness and recovering access to dimensions of ourselves that we had forgotten. And here something fundamental appears:

The Game has levels.

It was not designed with only one stage. When we learn how to play one level, we can move to the next. We learn that new level, practice, acquire new abilities, and move forward again. And so on, infinitely. The Game has no limits because it is based on evolution, and evolution is expansive by nature. But there is something important to understand:

The Game is not about winning.

Evolution is not a competition, and consciousness is not a hierarchy of human value. Moving through different levels does not make one person superior to another. Each being is having a different experience, at a different moment, with different lessons and different choices.

Learning the true rules of the game means beginning to enter the matrix behind what we perceive: understanding the laws of energy, geometry, mind, body, consciousness, soul, and the creation of reality. What happens when we begin to understand what exists behind the screen? What happens when we connect with the soul and the memory of the soul? What new abilities emerge? What do we become? And here another element becomes essential: discernment.

Expanding our perception does not mean believing everything we perceive.

Consciousness also requires discernment. An intuition, a vision, a message, or an energetic experience can contain information, symbolism, projection, or interpretation. Part of learning to play consciously is developing the ability to observe, question, and integrate what we receive without automatically turning it into truth. The more we expand our perception, the more important discernment becomes.

From the Third to the Fifth Dimension

When we speak about the third, fourth, and fifth dimensions, we are not using the same classification as the five dimensions of reality described at the beginning. The five dimensions described earlier refer to layers of our existence. In contrast, 3D, 4D, and 5D describe evolutionary states of consciousness.

The third dimension corresponds to a state of consciousness predominantly identified with material reality, personality, the human mind, and the structures we have built within this reality.

The fourth dimension is the transition: the moment when previous structures begin to break down, perception expands, and we begin to recognize that other dimensions of ourselves and reality exist. It is a space of deprogramming, transformation, and reorganization. The fifth dimension is a state of greater integration. It is the moment when the avatar consciously restores its connection with the player and begins to operate from a multidimensional understanding of itself and reality. This is where other forms of knowledge and other abilities for existing and creating reality begin to emerge.

And there is enormous potential here, because creating reality exclusively from the limited human mind, from the material and the temporal, has limitations. There is another way of creating, connected to mind, energy, and magic, if we want to call it that—not only through doing, time, and effort.

What is the difference between creating from the human mind and creating from the mind of the soul?

This is one of the things we are going to explore in Mexico. When we speak about a new humanity and a new era, this knowledge is one of its foundations, because in order to create a different reality, we first need to expand our understanding of what reality is. But this evolution does not happen only at the individual level. We are all inside the same Game. We all participate in the same system, and therefore there is also a collective dimension to this transformation.

VI —

The Software: Updating the Game from within

Here I am entering into something that comes directly from my personal experience and from what has been explained to me by the beings I work with. To understand it, we can continue using the same metaphor: The Game is the experience. The software is the system that allows that experience to function. And the codes are the information that organizes that software. This software was created a very long time ago, millions of years ago.

Originally, it was created as an open system. Many beings from different places were able to enter with their own codes, make adjustments, incorporate improvements, and also generate interference. Over time, this program accumulated viruses, unnecessary files, obsolete systems, and different forms of interference. And the disconnection between the avatars and their players also affected the functioning of the program. The cosmic beings and creators of this universe have an interest in this program functioning properly because they themselves move in and out of it.

They also want to have good human experiences, and they want human reality to continue evolving toward higher states of consciousness. This is why there is a project to restore the original code, and that plan is already underway. Because we are talking about an extremely complex system, these processes can take thousands of years and involve many beings from many different places.

A fundamental part of this process is for as many human beings as possible to recover their connection with their players, so that these souls can once again take control of the game and move toward its next stages.

The Individual Code and the Collective Code

There are two scales operating simultaneously. There is an individual code: our genetic, energetic, human, familial, ancestral, and soul information. And there is also a collective code: the structures and programs that organize the human and planetary experience. The two are interconnected.

When we modify our own information, we also intervene in the system of which we are part. And when the collective system transforms, new possibilities become available to the individuals within it.

This is why, in order to recover the code, clean it, and repair it, it is not enough to work from the outside. We need to enter the program and work from within: clean it, remove what has become obsolete, and install new codes and programs capable of updating the system. This work is happening from above and below simultaneously. It is collaborative work. Hundreds of thousands of souls have incarnated during this planetary moment to participate in this project.

And the fact that you are seeking to awaken this memory is not only the result of a human desire. It also has to do with a deeper calling from your own souls. Souls that want to recover sovereignty over their avatar, their reality, their dimension, and their experience. Souls that want to participate and remember. And when we speak about recovering that sovereignty, ultimately we are talking about something much simpler:

Returning to the origin.

VII —

Returning to the origin

Returning to the origin does not mean becoming higher masters, becoming something different, or abandoning our human experience in order to return somewhere else.

Returning to the origin means recovering the memory of the player without abandoning the avatar.

It means remembering, reconnecting, reconfiguring, and integrating: Remembering who we are. Reconnecting the avatar with the player. Reconfiguring what interferes with that connection. And integrating that consciousness into our human lives. Because ultimately, we did not come here to stop being human. We came here to live the human experience. The difference is where we live it from.

Sovereignty

And here another fundamental concept appears: sovereignty. Sovereignty does not mean that the avatar controls everything that happens. It means that the avatar stops operating exclusively through its conditioning, fears, inherited programs, and the external structures that told it who it was supposed to be.

Recovering sovereignty means consciously reestablishing communication with the player, learning to listen again to that broader intelligence, and recognizing ourselves as active participants in our own experience. The first step is opening ourselves to the possibility. The second is exploring it. And after that, each person decides how far they want to go, because free will is always operating. Every person, every human being, and every avatar has the right to live their human life in whatever way they choose.

There are souls that come into this reality and do not want to remember their soul origin. They want to live a completely human experience, and that is also their right. Not every human being is called to remember. But there are other souls that did come here to remember.

They came to participate in the project, to support the human project, to reconfigure their programs, and to restore their own codes—the codes of their lineages, their families, and future lineages. This space is intended for those who feel that calling.

The Transition

Remembering does not mean simply accessing more light, more knowledge, or more potential. Remembering involves transformation. And every transformation has a transition. Returning to the origin requires deprogramming ourselves and releasing patterns and beliefs installed within our system. It may mean changing the way we are, the way we relate to others, our habits, our work, our relationships, or the way we understand our lives.

This is the transition of the fourth dimension: the space between an identity that is beginning to fall away and a new understanding of ourselves that we are still learning to integrate. That transition can be uncomfortable. It requires our desire to evolve, personal work, and the updating of our habits, our thought patterns, and our ways of understanding reality. Ceremonies can deeply activate this process, but afterward it continues through our everyday lives.

It requires attention, effort, and courage, because sometimes beginning to see reality from another perspective means becoming unfamiliar to some people, seeing things we could not see before, and understanding human suffering from new perspectives. It means removing the veil. And that can hurt too. But perhaps one of the clearest signs of evolution is not how much we can perceive, but how we live. How we treat others. How we respond to fear. How much responsibility we take for our choices. How honestly we are able to look at ourselves. How much freedom we have from our own conditioning.

And how capable we become of creating without harming ourselves, others, or the world around us.

Because expanding consciousness without integrating it into the way we live would only be another form of disconnection.

Tulum

In Mexico, we are going to work with all of these layers: the cosmic, the evolutionary, and our potential, but also the human, the emotional, and the concrete. Because we still have families, relationships, jobs, projects, and human lives. This is not about escaping this reality. It is about expanding it. It is not about ceasing to be human. It is about remembering everything else that we also are. It is not about abandoning The Game. It is about learning to play consciously.

Each person will experience what corresponds to them: what each soul brings, what each reconfiguration requires, and what each avatar has come to find. This gathering will be only the beginning of a greater transformation toward new levels of consciousness, new abilities to create reality, and new possibilities in the way we live. As we restore our codes and update our systems, we also begin to become antennas for this frequency and this information. We begin to transmit higher frequencies that interact with the quantum field and with what happens around us.

From there, we can naturally become healers, inspirers, catalysts, and agents of transformation—not necessarily because we need to do something specific or take on a new identity, but simply because we have reactivated our original code.

✷

Perhaps the purpose of remembering the cosmic is not to become less human, but to become more fully human.

We did not come here to become something superior. We came to recover something we already are.

We did not come here to escape the human experience. We came to live it with greater consciousness.

We did not come here to abandon The Game. We came to remember that we are playing.

Because ultimately, The Game is also the story of an avatar who forgot that it had a player. An avatar who, for a long time, believed that its character was everything it was, until it began to remember: To remember who it is. Where it comes from. Why it is here. How The Game works. That other dimensions of reality exist. That it is not alone. And that there is a player. And from that connection, we can consciously enter The Game again, knowing that there are still many levels left to explore.
